apps.name: App Bazaar
apps.tagline: All our apps in one app: install and update them on your phone or TV
apps.description: The App Bazaar store as an app. It lists every app on apps.bulkbazaar.ca with its picture and description. Press Install and it downloads the app and opens Android's installer for you. Apps you already have show Open, and Update when a newer version is out; the Updates tab lists them all. New apps added to App Bazaar appear in the app by themselves. Works with a TV remote on Google TV, Android TV and Fire TV, and with touch on phones and tablets. App Bazaar updates itself too.
apps.whatsNew: Update all button at the top of every screen. On Android 12 and newer, updates install by themselves without tapping Install.

apps.name: Cable TV
apps.tagline: Free live TV channels by country, on your phone or TV
apps.description: Watch live channels that broadcasters stream publicly, sorted by country. Opens on Pakistani, Indian (Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi) and Canadian channels, with a channel grid, logos, search, favourites and a full-screen player. Works with TV remotes, supports picture-in-picture, and can also play your own M3U playlist. The app updates itself when a new version is out.
apps.whatsNew: Version 1.9.45: Free Live TV is now called Cable TV. Same free app, channels, favourites and settings.

apps.name: Live TV Max
apps.tagline: Live channels, a TV guide, movies and dramas on one home screen
apps.description: A streaming-style home screen for free live TV: big channel cards in rows by country and by language, with a live preview of the highlighted channel. Many channels show what's on now and next. Urdu and Hindi dramas, movies, shows and kids' programmes from the channels' own official uploads sit in the same rows, with a row to continue what you started. Installs next to Cable TV, needs no sign-in, works with TV remotes and updates itself.

apps.name: Iqra Quran
apps.tagline: Learn to read the Quran from alif, read it with audio, and memorize it
apps.description: A free Quran app for the whole family, in Urdu or English. Kids Qaida takes children step by step from the letters (alif, baa, taa) through zabar, zer, pesh, tanween, madd, jazm and tashdeed to whole Quran words and short surahs, with tap-to-hear cards, a Play all mode for learning together on the TV, quizzes and stars for each child. Read Quran has all 114 surahs in the Indo-Pak script with Urdu and English translation and recitation by famous qaris, including Al-Husary's slow teaching recitation. Hifz repeats each ayah as many times as you like with a pause to repeat it, lets you hide the text to test yourself, and plans your Sabaq, Sabqi and Manzil revision. No sign-in, no ads, works with TV remotes and updates itself.
apps.whatsNew: 10 reading themes that are easy on the eyes (new: Sky, Soft grey e-ink, Midnight blue). Every colour can be changed: background, Quran text, headings, highlight, top bar, Qaida cards and the home buttons.

apps.name: Live Cam
apps.tagline: Watch your CCTV and IP cameras live, on phone or Google TV
apps.description: This app is specially designed for Android TVs and Wyze cameras: sign in with your Wyze username and password, and all your Wyze cameras appear live in one grid. Tap or press OK for full screen with sound. You can also add other cameras by brand and IP address (Hikvision, Dahua, Amcrest, Lorex, Reolink, Tapo, Uniview, ONVIF and more) or paste any RTSP or HTTP address. Your logins stay on your device, and the app updates itself.

apps.name: Multi Chat
apps.tagline: All your WhatsApp accounts in one app, on your PC and phone
apps.description: Use several WhatsApp accounts at the same time, each in its own separate box: business, personal and more. Each account is the official WhatsApp Web, signed in with its own QR code (or “Log in with phone number” on the same phone), so nothing is modified and your accounts stay safe. Give every account a name, colour and photo, see its unread count, and get notifications that say which account a message is for. Mute an account or set quiet hours, save quick replies and type them into a chat with one tap, and lock the app with a PIN (or fingerprint on the phone). On a Windows PC you can show all accounts side by side, and it runs in the tray. Multi Chat never sends messages by itself, and it is not made by or connected with WhatsApp or Meta.
apps.whatsNew: First version, for Windows PCs and Android phones.
